regex_flatten :: list(tsubstr) -> tfullstr

regex_reverse_cdr :: list(t0) -> list(t0)

regex_cons :: t0 -> list(t0) -> list(t0)

regex_car :: list(t0) -> t0

regex_cdr :: list(t0) -> list(t0)

regex_map :: (t0 -> t1) -> list(t0) -> list(t1)

replace_if_match_split :: tfullstr -> tsubstr -> tsubstr -> tfullstr
(lambda (lambda (lambda (regex_flatten (regex_map (lambda (regex_if (regex_match $1 $0) $2 $0)) (regex_split '.' $2))))))
description: A function that replaces a substring in a full string based on a condition. It checks if the substring matches a pattern in the full string, and if so, replaces it with another substring. The full string is split by a delimiter before processing.

replace_concat_with_cdr_split :: tfullstr -> tsubstr -> tsubstr -> tfullstr
(lambda (lambda (lambda (regex_flatten (regex_cons (regex_concat $0 $1) (regex_cdr (regex_split '.' $2)))))))
description: A function that replaces the concatenation of two substrings in a full string with the rest of the string after splitting by a delimiter.

vowel_consonant_regex :: tsubstr
(regex_or 'a' (regex_or 'e' (regex_or 'i' (regex_or 'o' 'u'))))
description: A regular expression pattern that matches vowels ('a', 'e', 'i', 'o', 'u') in a substring.

replace_substrings_based_on_condition :: tfullstr -> (tsubstr -> tsubstr) -> tfullstr
(lambda (lambda (regex_flatten (regex_map $0 (regex_split '.' $1)))))
description: A function that replaces substrings in a full string based on a condition provided by a transformation function. It splits the full string by a delimiter, applies the transformation function to each substring, and then flattens the result back into a full string.

replace_concat_end_with_reversed_substr :: tfullstr -> tsubstr -> tsubstr -> tfullstr
(lambda (lambda (lambda (regex_flatten (regex_append (regex_concat $0 $1) (regex_reverse_cdr (regex_reverse_cdr (regex_split empty_string $2))))))))
description: A function that replaces the concatenation of the first and second substrings at the end of a full string with the reversed substring obtained by splitting the third substring by an empty string.

replace_end_with_reversed_substr :: tfullstr -> tsubstr -> tfullstr
(lambda (lambda (regex_flatten (regex_append $0 (regex_reverse_cdr (regex_split '.' $1))))))
description: A function that replaces the end of a full string with the reversed substring obtained by splitting the provided substring by a delimiter.

append_substring_to_end :: tfullstr -> tsubstr -> tfullstr
(lambda (lambda (regex_flatten (regex_append $0 (regex_split empty_string $1)))))
description: A function that appends a substring to the end of a full string, splitting the substring by an empty string before appending.

replace_start_with_cdr_split :: tfullstr -> tsubstr -> tfullstr
(lambda (lambda (regex_flatten (regex_cons $0 (regex_cdr (regex_split '.' $1))))))
description: A function that replaces the start of a full string with the rest of the string after splitting by a delimiter.

replace_vowel_with_consonant :: tsubstr -> tsubstr -> tfullstr -> tfullstr
(lambda (lambda (lambda (replace_if_match_split $0 (regex_concat $1 $2) vowel_consonant_regex))))
description: A function that replaces vowels in a full string with a specified consonant substring. It concatenates the provided substrings and uses a regular expression pattern to identify vowels for replacement.

add_substring_before_match :: tsubstr -> tsubstr -> tfullstr -> tfullstr
(lambda (lambda (lambda (replace_if_match_split $0 (regex_concat $1 $2) $2))))
description: A function that adds a specified substring before a matching substring in a full string based on a condition. It concatenates the provided substrings and uses the full string as the input for the replacement operation.
